correctness.rationale: For each N, a weighted-mass partition yields a rank-N interpolant with error (1+o(1))Q/(2N). The N disjoint signed inputs have zero u-integral on their intervals and disjoint tent outputs of norm (1-o(1))Q/(2N); rank-nullity proves the lower bound for every rank-<N map. Hence the two limits match.
